title: Schneider Electric Full Year 2025 Results
excerpt: Sales growth in pure Data Center remained at a strong double-digit level, year-over-year in Q4.
summary: Schneider Electric's February 26 FY2025 release reports EUR 40.152 billion revenue, up 8.9% organically, EUR 7.520 billion adjusted EBITA at an 18.7% margin, EUR 4.635 billion free cash flow, EUR 8.59 adjusted EPS, and EUR 13.721 billion year-end net debt. Pure data-centre demand accelerated sharply and the group reported strong uptake across electrical panels, UPS, racks, prefabricated solutions and liquid cooling. Data-centre growth also supported commissioning, modernization and maintenance services. The group entered 2026 targeting 7-10% organic revenue growth and 10-15% organic adjusted EBITA growth before upgrading that target at H1.
